sentinel_policy.reason: Prevent temporal leakage by using only Sentinel observations acquired at or before the FIRMS timestamp.

methodology_notes: This is a satellite evidence sampling dataset, not a training dataset.
Sampling intentionally covers multiple years, OSM contexts, temporal behaviors, thermal intensities and geographic cells.
Sampling groups are not source labels.
Latitude/longitude and grid IDs are sampling/GIS metadata and are not automatically model predictors.
Sentinel imagery will use a past-only 14-day search window.
Missing satellite observations will be represented explicitly rather than replaced with fabricated values.
